question: What claim about transmission is at stake in asserting that a teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover to the beloved?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is in view.
That teaching was told by an earth-mover.
It was told to the beloved.
inference: An earth-mover transmitted a teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters to the beloved.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: By the earth-mover, O beloved, the teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told.
